description.zh:
給定一個數字串列，尋找並列印僅在串列中出現一次的元素。 元素必須按照它們在原始清單中出現的順序列印。

C++ 注意：Python 清單對應於 C++ 中的 std::vector。讀取大小或整行，然後按索引遍歷。
description.en:
Given a list of numbers, find and print the elements that appear in the list only once. The elements must be printed in the order in which they occur in the original list.

C++ note: Python lists correspond to std::vector in C++. Read the size or the complete line, then traverse by index.

hint.zh: Python list 在此章對應 C++ 的 vector；先讀取數量或整行資料，再用索引走訪。
hint.en: Python lists correspond to std::vector in C++. Read the size or the complete line, then traverse by index.
